Here's my review of the git diff:

===== Issues Found =====

1. Future Date in Changelog
- Severity: Low
- Location: 
  - CHANGELOG/CHANGELOG-3.5.md line 7 (2026-07-23)
  - CHANGELOG/CHANGELOG-3.6.md line 7 (2026-07-23)
  - CHANGELOG/CHANGELOG-3.7.md line 7 (2026-07-23)
- Description: All changelogs contain a future date (2026-07-23) which appears to be a placeholder. This could cause confusion about actual release dates.

2. Security Advisory References
- Severity: High
- Location:
  - CHANGELOG/CHANGELOG-3.5.md line 19 (GHSA-6vch-q96h-7gc3)
  - CHANGELOG/CHANGELOG-3.6.md line 19 (GHSA-6vch-q96h-7gc3)
  - CHANGELOG/CHANGELOG-3.7.md line 19 (GHSA-6vch-q96h-7gc3)
- Description: Multiple references to security advisory GHSA-6vch-q96h-7gc3. While this is good practice, reviewers should verify these are real advisories and the fixes are properly implemented.

3. Dependency Version Bumps
- Severity: Medium
- Location:
  - CHANGELOG/CHANGELOG-3.6.md line 23 (CVE-2026-*)
  - CHANGELOG/CHANGELOG-3.7.md line 25 (GHSA-hrxh-6v49-42gf)
- Description: Multiple dependency version bumps with security fixes. The CVEs referenced (CVE-2026-*) appear to use future years, which may indicate placeholder values.

===== Non-Critical Observations =====

1. Consistent Formatting:
- The changelog updates maintain consistent formatting across all versions (3.5, 3.6, 3.7)

2. Version Number Updates:
- All files show appropriate version number increments (e.g., v3.5.33 → v3.5.34)

3. Security Focus:
- Good practice of linking security fixes to their respective advisories/CVEs

===== Recommendations =====
1. Replace future dates (2026-07-23) with actual release dates or "TBC" if unknown
2. Verify all security advisory links are valid and point to real advisories
3. Confirm CVE numbers (especially those with 2026 prefix) are accurate
4. Ensure all dependency version bumps have been properly tested

The changes appear to be routine maintenance updates with a focus on security fixes, but the placeholder dates and potential placeholder CVE numbers should be verified.
